project.name: nuevo_booking
project.description: New project with all diagram types

58bd92ff-8214-423e-9804-f97e6634827f.constraint:
context Person
inv ValidEmail:
    self.email.matches('^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$')

context Person
inv ValidPhoneNumber:
    self.phone_number.matches('^\\+?[0-9]{7,15}$')

26bb3c59-68d9-4350-8cc4-e7295fbf5955.constraint:
context Booking
inv NumberOfGuestsDoesNotExceedRoomCapacity:
    self.guests->size() <= self.rooms->collect(r | r.max_people)->sum()


context Booking
inv NoRoomDoubleBooking:
    self.rooms.booking->select(b |
        b.id <> self.id and
        self.booking_status <> canceled and
        b.booking_status <> canceled and
        self.check_in < b.check_out and
        b.check_in < self.check_out
    )->isEmpty()

context Booking

inv CheckInBeforeCheckOut:
    self.check_in <= self.check_out
